title: FPI Inflows Surge To ₹76,189 Crore In November As Foreign Investors Return After Two Months Of Selling
description: Foreign portfolio investors invested ₹76,188.75 crore in Indian equities between Nov 3 and Nov 13, reversing two months of heavy selling. Improving corporate earnings, attractive large-cap valuations and global concerns over artificial intelligence stocks supported sentiment. Reports of possible tax relief also boosted expectations, although uncertainties remain over sustained inflows
